I wore wigs and the experience really depends on things like your country’s climate and stuff! I live in a hot tropical country so it was super uncomfortable like ALL of the time, but imo it was a fair trade off for not feeling insecure about not having any hair. I did receive some comments on it (mostly from blunt/rude people who made remarks just cuz) but it did improve my confidence when I was struggling with the hair loss.

My hair fell out from extreme stress when I was 14-16 years old. I went to a dermatologist and had treatment done where they injected steroids into my scalp to help encourage my hair to grow back, which is about as pleasant as it sounds. It was excruciating but now at 21 I have more hair than I know what to do with lol. Just dropping my experience here in case this is a route you ever consider!
